title: Maximum Product Subarray
summary: Find the greatest product of a nonempty contiguous segment of the array.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–20000 integers in [−10,10]. Every contiguous product fits a signed 32-bit integer.

statement: Find the greatest product of a nonempty contiguous segment of the array.

examples.explanation: The two negatives make the whole product positive.
The zero is better than any negative single element.
The best segment is the first element.

constraints: 1–20000 integers in [−10,10]. Every contiguous product fits a signed 32-bit integer.
hints: Conceptual: A negative multiplier can turn the smallest product into the largest.
Directional: Track both extremes among segments ending at the current index.
Implementation: Compare starting a new segment with multiplying each previous extreme. Update the overall maximum.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
